newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC in Thai JV property development deal.
newsitem.headline: FCC in Thai JV property development deal.

text.p: Property firm First Capital Corp Ltd (FCC) said it signed a joint venture deal with Thailand's Sathorn Thani Co Ltd to develop property-based projects in the country.
The deal was "in line with FCC's current strategy of investing overseas to position itself as a meaningful regional property group", FCC said in a statement received by Reuters on Wednesday.
The joint venture would have an initial paid up capital of one million baht with Sathorn Thani holding a 51 percent stake.
